purpose: Within-site control. These entries are excluded from pre-rendered pages, sitemap.xml and directory.json for one cycle, so that citation rates for questions answered by holdout entries can be compared against questions answered by published entries.
selection_constraints: Never carrying a 24/7 crisis line or reachable from the crisis path.
ethical_note: Eight non-crisis entries stay less findable for one cycle in exchange for an interpretable result. This tradeoff must be restated in every report that uses the control arm. If any holdout entry is found on review to be crisis-adjacent, release it immediately and drop it from the analysis.

control_arm_coverage.assessment: UNDER-POWERED. Only two questions in v1 touch a holdout entry, and neither is answered exclusively by one. The v1 control arm therefore supports description only and cannot carry any comparison on its own. This is a known weakness, recorded before the baseline rather than discovered after it.
control_arm_coverage.fix_for_v2: Add eight dedicated probe questions, one per holdout entry, each answerable only by that entry. That turns the control arm from two partial items into eight clean ones.
